components.name: Small Shop
components.description: A corner shop on the main road. Pays TSh 8,000 a day.

components.name: Restaurant
components.description: Mama Ntilie's place. Pays TSh 25,000 a day.

components.name: House
components.description: A tidy family house to rent out. Pays TSh 12,000 a day.

components.name: Large Business
components.description: The Uptown trading house. Pays TSh 90,000 a day.

components.lockedText: The Uptown gate is chained. The guard wants 3 reputation stars first.

action.text: ATM: "Huduma haipatikani" - out of service. Try Mr. Juma inside.
Next bus to Uptown: as soon as the gate opens.

actions.text: You watch the water for a moment. Pole pole.

action.text: Market: north of the junction. Bank and Mama Ntilie: east. Park: north-east.

nod_neema_hero.speaker: Mama Neema
nod_neema_hero.text: Shujaa wangu! The parcel got to my sister in Dodoma. If you ever have tomatoes to sell, my stall pays well.

nod_neema_found.speaker: Mama Neema
nod_neema_found.text: Eeh! That is it, my parcel! Asante sana, asante! Here, let me take it before it walks off again.

nod_neema_thanks.speaker: Mama Neema
nod_neema_thanks.text: You are good people. Everybody in Hacho will hear about this.

nod_neema_looking.speaker: Mama Neema
nod_neema_looking.text: Still no parcel? Pole. Look BEHIND the stalls, up by the hedge. Small brown box, my name on it.

nod_neema_hello.speaker: Mama Neema
nod_neema_hello.text: Karibu Hacho! You must be the new one. I am Mama Neema; I have sold tomatoes on this square since before the fountain worked.

nod_neema_hello2.speaker: Mama Neema
nod_neema_hello2.text: Everyone here will want something from you, mostly errands. Pole pole, one thing at a time.

nod_neema_again.speaker: Mama Neema
nod_neema_again.text: Habari! Back again? The tomatoes are still red and I am still busy.

nod_neema_help2.speaker: Mama Neema
nod_neema_help2.text: Yes! A parcel for my sister went missing somewhere in this market. A porter dropped it, I think. Find it and I will pay you properly.

nod_neema_town.speaker: Mama Neema
nod_neema_town.text: The bank and Mama Ntilie are east of the junction. Asha runs the shop down the road. And the kid in the park loses things every single day.

nod_neema_bye.speaker: Mama Neema
nod_neema_bye.text: Haya, safari njema. Mind the piki-pikis.

nod_asha_hurry.speaker: Asha
nod_asha_hurry.text: Why are you still here? Mama Ntilie is waiting, east past the junction, blue roof. Haraka!

nod_asha_hello.speaker: Asha
nod_asha_hello.text: Karibu, Duka la Asha! Phone credit, tomatoes, and opinions, all fresh. Press E at my door if you want to buy.

nod_asha_again.speaker: Asha
nod_asha_again.text: Mambo! Buying, or running errands today?

nod_asha_job2.speaker: Asha
nod_asha_job2.text: Perfect timing. This order goes to Mama Ntilie at the restaurant. She wants it in ninety seconds or she cancels. Today pole pole is NOT the plan!

nod_asha_sell.speaker: Asha
nod_asha_sell.text: Phone credit for TSh 2,000, tomatoes for TSh 1,500. Between you and me, the market stall pays more for tomatoes than I charge. Do not tell Mama Neema I said so.

nod_asha_bye.speaker: Asha
nod_asha_bye.text: Haya. Come back when your pockets are heavier.

nod_baraka_play.speaker: Baraka
nod_baraka_play.text: Simba forever! When I am famous I will buy you a whole shop. Two shops!

nod_baraka_found.speaker: Baraka
nod_baraka_found.text: MY BALL! Asante, asante, asante! I promise I will kick it in the OTHER direction now.

nod_baraka_looking.speaker: Baraka
nod_baraka_looking.text: Did you look near the big trees at the back of the park? It rolled that way. Probably. Maybe.

nod_baraka_hello.speaker: Baraka
nod_baraka_hello.text: Shikamoo! I am Baraka, number 7, future Taifa Stars striker. Are you good at finding things?

nod_baraka_again.speaker: Baraka
nod_baraka_again.text: You again! Still good at finding things?

nod_baraka_job2.speaker: Baraka
nod_baraka_job2.text: I kicked my ball too hard and now it is gone. Somewhere in the park. Mama will shout if I come home without it.

nod_baraka_shirt.speaker: Baraka
nod_baraka_shirt.text: Number 7! Like the best player in the whole world. Also it was the only one left at the market.

nod_kombo_hello.speaker: Mzee Kombo
nod_kombo_hello.text: Karibu, karibu. Mzee Kombo, bus station master, timetable expert, tea drinker. No bus right now, so sit if you like.

nod_kombo_again.speaker: Mzee Kombo
nod_kombo_again.text: Habari za leo? Still no bus. There is always tea.

options.text: What's behind that gate to the north-east?

nod_kombo_where.speaker: Mzee Kombo
nod_kombo_where.text: Dar es Salaam, Arusha, Dodoma... and one goes to Uptown, past the big gate. When the gate is open, that is.

nod_kombo_uptown.speaker: Mzee Kombo
nod_kombo_uptown.text: Uptown. Big houses, a trading house for sale, people who say "hello" in English. The guard only lets in people the town trusts. Three stars of reputation, he says.

nod_juma_congrats2.speaker: Mr. Juma
nod_juma_congrats2.text: A property owner! I knew it. Income arrives every morning. Next: the restaurant, the house, and one day, Uptown.

nod_juma_hello.speaker: Mr. Juma
nod_juma_hello.text: Karibu, Hacho Community Bank. Mr. Juma, manager. We do savings, loans, and free advice. The advice is the best product.

nod_juma_again.speaker: Mr. Juma
nod_juma_again.text: Ah, my favourite customer. Advice today?

options.text: How do I get ahead in this town?

nod_juma_advice2.speaker: Mr. Juma
nod_juma_advice2.text: Property. A small shop on the main road is for sale for TSh 250,000. Buy it and it pays TSh 8,000 every day, while you sleep. Missions and coins get you there.

nod_juma_uptown.speaker: Mr. Juma
nod_juma_uptown.text: Reputation. Return what people lose, run their errands, open a business. Three stars and the gate guard becomes very polite.

nod_juma_bye.speaker: Mr. Juma
nod_juma_bye.text: Karibu tena. The ATM outside is, as always, out of service.

nod_ntilie_got.speaker: Mama Ntilie
nod_ntilie_got.text: Ah, Asha's order! Still warm, still on time. Asante, mwanangu. Sit, have some chai, you have earned it.

nod_ntilie_hello.speaker: Mama Ntilie
nod_ntilie_hello.text: Karibu, karibu! Wali maharage, chipsi mayai, chai ya tangawizi. Everything is ready, nothing is fast. That is the secret.

nod_ntilie_again.speaker: Mama Ntilie
nod_ntilie_again.text: Habari! Hungry, or delivering? Asha sends her orders with whoever walks past.

nod_hamisi_hello.speaker: Mzee Hamisi
nod_hamisi_hello.text: Shikamoo... no wait, I am the elder, YOU say shikamoo. Ha! Karibu. I am Hamisi. I sit here and know things.

nod_hamisi_tip.speaker: Mzee Hamisi
nod_hamisi_tip.text: Looking for work? Mama Neema at the market always needs a hand. Asha does deliveries. The kid in the park loses things. And Mr. Juma at the bank will tell you to buy property. He is right.

nod_zawadi_neighbour.speaker: Bibi Zawadi
nod_zawadi_neighbour.text: So you bought the house next door! Good. The last tenant played the radio at 5 a.m. You do not play the radio at 5 a.m., yes?

nod_zawadi_hello.speaker: Bibi Zawadi
nod_zawadi_hello.text: Karibu mtaani. The house with the sign is for sale, TSh 400,000. Good roof, quiet street, one nosy neighbour. Me.

qst_welcome.name: Welcome to Hacho
qst_welcome.description: You just arrived in Hacho. Find Mama Neema on the market square, north of the junction, and say hello.

steps.text: Talk to Mama Neema at the market

qst_lost_package.name: Lost Package
qst_lost_package.description: Mama Neema's parcel went missing in the market. Search behind the stalls and bring it back to her.

steps.text: Find the package in the market

qst_quick_delivery.name: Quick Delivery
qst_quick_delivery.description: Take Asha's order to Mama Ntilie at the restaurant, east of the junction, before the timer runs out.

steps.text: Deliver to Mama Ntilie before the timer runs out

onFail.text: Too late! The order was cancelled.

qst_ball.name: Baraka's Ball
qst_ball.description: Baraka kicked his football somewhere into the park. Find it near the trees and bring it back to him.

steps.text: Find the football in the park
Give the ball back to Baraka

qst_first_property.name: Open for Business
qst_first_property.description: Mr. Juma says property is the way up. Save TSh 250,000 and buy the Small Shop for sale on the main road.

rewards.text: Open for Business! +100 XP  +1 reputation. Income arrives every morning.

qst_uptown.name: Uptown Access
qst_uptown.description: The Uptown gate opens only for people the town trusts. Earn 3 reputation stars by returning lost things and opening a business, then walk in.

steps.text: Earn 3 reputation stars (help people around town)
